method.allocation: One third of the $50 setup risk per leg; size each leg from its own entry-to-SL distance. No redistribution for unfilled/omitted legs.
method.entry: Next M15 open minus 10%, 25%, 50% of final confirming candle body for BUY; plus for SELL. No immediate/open entry.
method.exits: Exact original archived SL and TP frozen for every leg; individual entry reward/risk therefore varies.
method.expiry: Pending legs expire at the end of the immediate next M15 candle, or earlier at the first common TP/SL touch. Filled legs remain until common SL/TP.
method.capVariants: Primary exact levels do not apply the old maximum price-risk cap. Sensitivity clamps pending-entry setups to an entry no worse than the original capped entry. Both retain the same fixed-dollar risk budget.
method.intrabar: Enumerates all continuous event orders consistent with next-bar OHLC, including partial fills before TP. Not restricted to two monotonic OHLC paths. Later double-touch bars branch to SL and TP. Dollar range is the sum of per-setup extremes, not a confidence interval or guaranteed realizable portfolio path.
method.costs: Gross USD; no spread, commission, financing, lot rounding, slippage or gap execution loss. Planned fill and exit prices assumed.
method.portfolio: No compounding, no simultaneous-position or shared-margin limits; independent setup risk can overlap. Starting balance is illustrative, not the actual account balance.
method.data: 227 matched previously qualified setups, 46 buys/181 sells; Aug 3-Nov 11, 2026; completed OANDA M15 history through Nov 13. Existing filters inherited, not recomputed at changed entry prices; not a fresh signal scan.
method.validation: Prior source SHA256 hashes verified; original 131TP/88SL/$2150 baseline asserted; synthetic event-order, partial-fill, expiry and stop checks passed; side and monthly PnL reconcile; each setup planned SL loss <=$50.
method.changes: Research artifacts only. No dashboard source, live settings or broker orders changed.
